items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 23 at 2:53PM AKDT until May 24 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues.

* WHERE...Holy Cross

* WHEN...Until 100 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Extensive flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other
low-lying and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- As of Thursday evening, the ice jam near Holy Cross released.
Water levels are receding in Holy Cross and continue to fall,
but three days of inundation has left substantial stranded
water and the airport runway is still inoperable.
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by ice jams continues to be possible.
